author: Xuph
body:
{tag=cad8013ab98a40679f0981b0734e0085}, {tag=c29bef37d8e242a9b74604f2df78f374} and I {tag=9116d3fa14004adaaecd2eae1d73e383} are happy to present you the first map in our map series; Twilight: Mars! 

The map features:
- FFA 16-24 players
- 8 chests spread around the map with adjustment between its loot and how hard is it to get
- A very unique block pallette, and original design
- Flat ground for PvP, structures, mountains, volcano and more
- Barrier border around the map (no void)
- 3 lives (you dont get the loadout you had when you respawn)
- Kill rewards 
- Random spawnpoints spread across the map


IMGUR ALBUM: (view all of the images with the subtitles under them otherwise you will have no idea how the map works/looks/plays):
http://imgur.com/a/PuCMq

Thanks to {tag=71a5754115dd4df99eb6b591df9859a1} for the pictures in shaders! ily babe

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
As a builder, builders may get their maps instantly accepted. It's part of the perks as a builder, because after reviewing them we notice that they are high quality and it's another map we can add without the long period of review. We're migrating systems to review on GitHub right now, we have map developer inactivity & got through demoting one, we have a lot on our agenda to do Arcade, Sky Wars, Frenzy, & Walls, and we're also focused on internal changes (adapting to XML still, new features, etc.) and new maps, especially in DTM, are our lowest priority.

From highest to lowest priority (at least in my view, I'll be honest):
- Sky Wars submissions
- Walls submissions / Frenzy submissions
- King of the Hill submissions / Capture the Flag submissions
- Arcade submissions
- Capture the Wool submissions
- Destroy the Monument submissions
- Team Deathmatch submissions
- Tournament submissions (officials generally do this.)

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We're adapting to things, and some maps aren't our priority. We need map developers to answer maps and give feedback on whether or not they're accepted, but most are not fulfilling that goal.

I'm trying to give feedback when I can: it's hard to accept and deny with such a low amount of responses to said map. The acceptance system is very slow right now, and we're at an activity check right now.

If you have complaints about a map developer or how the system is currently working, please message Legoche or Fouled as they are head map developers and can provide more information than I currently can at this time.
